text:
maria: Heads-up — I started a proposal for stricter catalog entry gates. TL;DR: require perf benchmarks, eval pass on the canonical prompt-suite, and a customer-commitments section for any pin exceptions. Need quick alignment before Q3 planning.

sanjay: +1. can we make perf SLOs explicit? e.g., p50/p95/p99 targets, cost per 1k tokens, memory footprint.

elaine: Also need migration runway: deprecation notice windows, grace periods, migration assist (compat shims + client migration docs).

dave: Customer asks: some enterprise customers need pins for 6-12 months, willing to pay for reserved capacity. Proposal: treat pin exceptions as a paid add-on with documented SLAs.

maria: sketching an acceptance checklist — posting a minimal draft below. feedback welcome.

```
- perf: p95 <= 300ms @ 512 tokens; p99 <= 700ms (tiering discussed below)
- cost: baseline <= 0.75x reference model cost per 1k tokens
- quality: eval pass >= 92% on prod prompt-suite (per-major-version)
- stability: no OOMs during 1M token/day soak; <1% error rate at peak
- infra: quantization/compat notes + memory footprint doc
- privacy/compliance: KMS integration documented; data retention policy specified
- migration: deprecation notice >= 90 days; migration plan + compatibility shim or adapter
- pin-exception: documented customer commitment + revenue/ops trade (paid SLA)
```

sanjay: p99 700ms feels loose for low-latency apps. suggest tiering (standard/premium/enterprise) with explicit thresholds per tier.

maria: agree — propose: standard = p95<=300, p99<=600; premium tighter (p95<=200, p99<=350); enterprise negotiable + reserved capacity.

kai: we also need a process for pin revocation: product/eng owners must supply migration artifacts or request extended pin. Add rollback criteria for spectral regressions.

elaine: add a customer incentive: reduced migration fees or credit if they opt into pilot migrations within the 90-day window. helps adoption.

olivia: legal note: pin exceptions must be reflected in contract language (term, notice, termination rights). Provide a template clause.

ops-bot: deploybot: created internal doc stub at /docs/catalog/gates/2398503210 (auto-generated link).

dave: next steps: maria to draft final rubric; sanjay + kai add perf/test thresholds; elaine to draft comms + migration incentives; olivia to prepare contract clause. sync tomorrow 10:30am.

maria: thanks all — will push the draft to #docs and tag folks. :thumbsup:
